test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution’.

Harsha is the tallest __than all the other boys__ in his colony.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the original sentence is the incorrect comparison structure. 
 
• When comparing Harsha's height to that of the other boys in his colony, the correct phrase to use is** "tallest of all the boys."**
 
• The phrase **"of all the boys" **indicates that Harsha is the tallest among all the boys in his colony.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **'of all the boys.'**

Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 3.'**

Correct Sentence:__ Harsha is the tallest** of all the boys** in his colony.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Option 1) no substitution:** This option does not address the error in the original sentence.
 
• **Option 2) than some other boys:** This option changes the meaning of the sentence by suggesting that Harsha is taller than only some of the other boys, rather than all of them.
 
• **Option 4) than any boy**: This option is grammatically incorrect and changes the meaning of the sentence. It suggests that Harsha is taller than any boy, which is not the intended comparison.
